post.message: LLM judge reported the PR title claims a fix that the changed non-test code does not plausibly exercise. Deterministic checks did not fire, but the judge's reading of intent vs. diff disagrees.
post.judgeRationale: The PR title claims to add a quality gate to the find kanpe pipeline, but the diff only updates the markdown documentation file (find-kanpe.md) to describe the new [0] quality gate step, without modifying any actual code.
